script.render: const s=ctx.state,gl=ctx.gl,u=ctx.uniforms;if(s.frequency!==u.u_frequency){s.frequency=u.u_frequency;const data=new Float32Array(64*64*4);for(let y=0;y<64;y++)for(let x=0;x<64;x++)data[(y*64+x)*4]=.65*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*u.u_frequency*x/64)+.35*Math.cos(2*Math.PI*3*y/64);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,s.buffers[0].texture);gl.texSubImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D,0,0,0,64,64,gl.RGBA,gl.FLOAT,data);const spectrum=s.transform(0,true);gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,s.buffers[spectrum].fbo);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,s.buffers[3].texture);gl.copyTexSubImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D,0,0,0,0,0,64,64);const inverse=s.transform(3,false);gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,s.buffers[inverse].fbo);const recovered=new Float32Array(data.length);gl.readPixels(0,0,64,64,gl.RGBA,gl.FLOAT,recovered);let error=0;for(let n=0;n<data.length;n++)error=Math.max(error,Math.abs(data[n]-recovered[n]));if(!Number.isFinite(error)||error>1e-4)throw Error('FFT round-trip failed: '+error);s.error=error;gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,null);gl.viewport(0,0,...ctx.resolution);}gl.useProgram(s.show);ctx.utils.bindTexture(s.show,'u_input',s.buffers[0].texture,0);ctx.utils.bindTexture(s.show,'u_spectrum',s.buffers[3].texture,1);ctx.utils.drawFullscreen(s.show);ctx.publish('view','Signal | frequency spectrum');ctx.publish('FFT round-trip error',s.error.toExponential(2));
